headline: Global Fashion Brands Divert $254M in Orders from Bangladesh to India
summary: Global apparel brands including Zara, H&M, and Marks & Spencer diverted $254 million in clothing orders from Bangladesh to India due to labor unrest.
why: Supply chain shifts caused by regional labor strikes impact manufacturing output and trade flows across the global textile and retail sectors.

impacts.name: Bangladesh
impacts.why: Orders were diverted away from Bangladesh manufacturers.
